sources.name: NASA POWER (climatology)
sources.access_method: Public REST API, no key, JSON
sources.resolution: Meteorology about 0.5 x 0.625 degrees (MERRA-2); solar about 1 x 1 degree (CERES)
sources.limitations: Modelled / satellite-derived, not a ground station. The grid is coarse for mountains: one cell averages peaks and valleys together.

sources.name: Standard-atmosphere pressure estimate
sources.resolution: Depends on the elevation value used
sources.limitations: An estimate from elevation only. Real pressure changes with weather and season.

sources.name: Curiosity REMS (Rover Environmental Monitoring Station)
sources.access_method: NASA Planetary Data System archive; published REMS papers and CAB weather reports
sources.limitations: A single site on Mars. The air-temperature sensor is affected by heat from the rover. Values stored here are published summary values, not the full archive.

sources.name: Earth Impact Database
sources.provider: Planetary and Space Science Centre, University of New Brunswick
sources.limitations: Ages of impact structures are given as ranges (Karakul: less than 5 million years).

sources.name: Team interpretation
sources.access_method: Written by the team from the cited literature
sources.limitations: An interpretation, not a measurement. Always shown with the "interpretation" label.

sources.name: MODIS Land Surface Temperature and NDVI (MOD11A2, MOD13Q1)
sources.access_method: AppEEARS point sample (Earthdata Login), CSV loaded with scripts/import_csv.php
sources.limitations: Clear-sky only: cloudy days are missing. Not yet loaded unless rows exist in the measurements table.

sources.name: LRO Diviner Lunar Radiometer
sources.access_method: Download from PDS, CSV loaded with scripts/import_csv.php
sources.limitations: Surface temperature only: the Moon has no air. Not yet loaded unless rows exist in the measurements table.

sources.name: SRTM GL1 / Copernicus DEM (elevation)
sources.provider: NASA LP DAAC / ESA Copernicus, via OpenTopography
sources.access_method: OpenTopography API (free key, server side only) or Earthdata Login
sources.limitations: Voids and errors on very steep slopes. Used to verify site elevations.

sources.name: MOLA Mars elevation (Mars Trek)
sources.limitations: Mars elevation is measured from the Mars areoid (datum), not from a sea level. It cannot be compared directly with Earth elevation.

sources.name: Mars Climate Database
sources.limitations: Climate-model output. Its authors give no warranty of validity. Not yet loaded.

sources.name: NASA GIBS map tiles
sources.resolution: Blue Marble base map, up to zoom level 8
sources.limitations: Base map picture only. No numbers are taken from it.

parameters.name: Surface pressure
parameters.explanation: Compared on a logarithmic scale: a 1000-fold difference gives similarity 0.

parameters.name: Mean surface (ground) temperature
parameters.explanation: Absolute difference: 100 K apart gives similarity 0.

parameters.name: Solar radiation at the surface
parameters.explanation: Relative difference between the two values.

parameters.name: Impact-crater geology
parameters.explanation: 1 if both sites are impact structures or both are not, otherwise 0.

parameters.name: Mean air temperature (2 m)
parameters.explanation: Context only. Used in the analog fingerprint.

parameters.name: Daily air temperature range
parameters.explanation: Monthly maximum minus monthly minimum of 2 m temperature (NASA POWER); annual = mean of 12 months. Larger than a true daily range. Context and fingerprint.

parameters.name: Vegetation index (NDVI)
parameters.explanation: Low values mean bare ground. Context only; Mars has no vegetation.

parameters.name: Impact-structure diameter
parameters.explanation: Context only. Used for the crater-to-crater picture.

esi.formula: ESI = sum(w_i * s_i) / sum(w_i) over the parameters that have both values
esi.disclaimer: Environmental Similarity Index for specific measurable parameters. It is not a validated habitat suitability score.
